complaint.standardised_narrative: On 12 August 2026 the complainant found an unauthorised debit of Rs. 40,000 from the Aadhaar-linked savings account. The transactions were recorded as AePS withdrawals at a Business Correspondent outlet in another district. No one-time password was shared and the debit card remained in the complainant's possession throughout.
